mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (place_id, store_id, price, order_status, ordered_at) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{storeId}, #{price}, #{orderStatus}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT O.order_id, O.store_id, O.price, O.order_status, O.ordered_at, P.place_name, P.place_id, M.menu_id FROM orders O JOIN order_menus OM ON O.order_id = OM.order_id JOIN places P ON O.place_id = P.place_id JOIN menus M ON OM.menu_id = M.menu_id WHERE O.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT O.order_id, O.store_id, O.price, O.order_status, O.ordered_at, P.place_name, P.place_id, M.menu_id FROM orders O JOIN order_menus OM ON O.order_id = OM.order_id JOIN places P ON O.place_id = P.place_id JOIN menus M ON OM.menu_id = M.menu_id WHERE P.place_id = #{placeId} AND O.order_status = 'UNPAID'
SELECT price FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
